title: Oddin: Latent Visual Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models via Self-Distillation from Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified large multimodal models (ULMMs) are able to perform visual reasoning through interleaved text-image generation, but generating explicit intermediate images incurs significant computational overhead. While visual latent reasoning addresses this, most existing methods rely on vision-language models (VLMs) incapable of visual generation. We propose Oddin, a novel framework enabling latent visual reasoning in ULMMs. Oddin replaces intermediate images with compact latent tokens processed entirely by the understanding branch, reserving the generation branch for the final output image. We train the model via offline self-distillation with three objectives, final image generation losses, text distillation losses, and cross-entropy losses for special tokens. tldr: Oddin提出了一种在统一多模态模型中用紧凑潜在token替代显式中间图像的潜在视觉推理框架，通过自蒸馏训练在视觉推理任务上超越了交错生成基线和闭源VLMs。
en_tdlr: Oddin introduces a novel framework for latent visual reasoning in unified multimodal models by replacing explicit intermediate images with compact latent tokens trained via self-distillation, surpassing interleaved generation baselines and closed-source VLMs on visual reasoning tasks.
